## (d) Waterfall and Shapley decomposition (descriptive; re-run after E17 and E18)

Target: SA level = ROC of the paper's SA arm; SA gain = SA arm - lp under the same probe and protocol. Factors switched from the released configuration to the fix: init (random = released path, `last_randinit` -> pretrained `last`); probe (W1/S1 released-code probe -> P1E/D24-A fixed probe); protocol (paper split, upstream labels and scoring -> corrected rotations, D24-A seeds; S1 has seed S_r only). 'scoring' = the post hoc test-scoring fix alone on the paper split (upstream -> fixed, P1E/W1 re-scored), the only protocol step that exists for the MLP head. Paper values: Table 1 ROC (mean ± SEM, 5 seeds). Unreproduced residual = paper - our released-path cell. ROC x100; [95% CI] from the E11 resampling (paper split: events/files then seeds; rotations: subjects then seeds), all cells resampled jointly.
